benchmark.allocation_investigation: Queued release adds one median allocation per operation because RetryDecision returns a *time.Time; Go escape analysis reports retryAt moved to heap. Other workloads have equal median allocations.
benchmark.comparison: Every pair has equal result signatures, normalized ordered SQL/argument fingerprints, and SQL/transaction/provider counts. Median p50 and p95 increase each <= max(5% of base, 1 ms).
benchmark.host_state: Ten sequential runs on one 16-core host after competing repository CI runs exited; no other CI, Go test, coverage, or Node test processes were observed immediately before or after the paired sequence.
benchmark.name: BenchmarkPrivacyOwnership
benchmark.query_fingerprint: Ordered SQL, argument type and value shape; generated UUIDs, timestamps, and hash values are normalized, and pointers are dereferenced. Fixed golden hashes separately pin hash bytes and ordered parts.

evaluation_waiver: Issue #485 records the maintainer-approved scoped historical deterministic 1k waiver; exact-base fixed-result, real PostgreSQL, paired performance, focused production-entry and final-head full production-image E2E are its replacement evidence.
